verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v1: yā man darā ʾannahu makhṣūṣu ʾamdāḥī bimā ḥawat min ṣifāti sh-shawqi ʾiṣlaḥī
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v2: jultu l-mawāmiyā judtu l-māla fī ṭalabi shaykha yurīnī thimāra l-waṣli lil-māḥī
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v3: ʿalawtu kulla talūli qad samā maʿa tas ʾāli ṭ-ṭarāʾiqi min dalīli ʾafrāḥī
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v4: ṣādaftu fī ʿalami yaʾawī ʾilā ʿalami yahdī lidhī karami wad-dāfiʿi d-dāḥī
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v5: shaykhi murabbi birabbi wad-di raḥimi shaykhi waḥiṣni ḥaṣīni dūna ʾatrāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v6: shaykhi razīni munīfi rāʾiqi karami maʾawā l-masākīni wal-ʾaytāmi sammāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v7: shaykhi ʾamīni waḍiḥḥi fī z-zamāni wakhiḍ rami khiḍammi ghazīri l-mawji sayyāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v8: shaykhi nafīsi wamiʿṭāʾi nafāʾisahu shaykhi muʿīni biʾāḥi ʾashbāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v9: shaykhi jarā dhikruhu biʾalsuni waʿalā ḥattā yudawwaru fī ʾaflaki ʾamdāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v10: shaykhi barā kabidī yā muntahā ʾamalī shaykhi ṭabībi qulūbi fāqa jaḥjāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v11: hākum ʾabā ʾaḥmada l-mashhūra mālikinā wazāʾirā ḥajja ʿan mazḥi waʾamrāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v12: wad-dayanu munhadimu l-ʾarkāni yarfaʿuhā waṣāra muʿtadila l-ʾarkāni yā ṣāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v13: yā sāʾilā sunana l-hādī washirʿatahu fīma l-ʾiqāmatu fī ḥawḍi waḍaḥḍāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v14: ʾurīka daʾamāʾa hadhā l-ʿaṣri qāʾidanā ʿan waḥlahi l-jahli fī ʾinqādhi ʾarwāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v15: ʾatā mina llāhi wal-mawlā l-karīmi lahu mā lam yaqaʿ taḥta ḥaṣri dūna ʾakdāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v16: wamā taḥḥaraka ʾillā fī riḍā maliki wamā tasakkana ʾillā fī raḍā l-māḥī
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v17: ʾabshir bimā tartajī min waṣlahi lidhurā taḥwī kuʾūsa l-munā min ʾasmaḥi r-rāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v18: falnaḥmidi llāha min qismi nukhaṣṣu bihi lam taʾatinā qismahu ḍīzā biʾakwāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v19: man ḥāzahu fī l-barāyā nāla maṭlabahu bushrā limushamahi min faḍli fattāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v20: man qāsahu sharafā wallāhi martabaha yarudduhu ʿajzuhu la ṭamḥu ṭammāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v21: maḥūṭu ḥifẓi ʾilahi l-ʿālamīna ʿalā hadhā z-zaʿīmi biʾamsāʾi waʾaṣbāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v22: lil-hi darruka yā miʿwānu yā sanadī ʾasīru wuddika fī taṭlabi ʾaflaḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v23: mā musmiʿu musmiʿu fīkum ḍarūratahu ʾila wayanjaḥu shaykhī dūna ʾilḥāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v24: ḥālī wasirrī maḥḍūrāni ʿindaka yā ṣindīdu taʿrifu mā ʿindī bʾatrāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v25: l-ḥamdu lil-hi rabbī min manāʾiḥihi lahu taṣarrufu ʾalwāḥi biʾalwāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v26: thumma ṣ-ṣalatu wataslīmu l-ʾilahi ʿalā munazzili l-qawli ʿan hazli waʾamzāḥi
verses.ya-man-dara-c1-v27: wal-ʾāli waṣ-ṣaḥbi ʾarbābi l-hudā wanadā kullu ʾatā maʿa ʾirshādi waʾiṣṣalaḥi
